title: Overemployed: How I Secretly Work Multiple Full-time Jobs (and you can too)
description:
Overemployed. Working 2 jobs or more at the same time. How is this possible? In this video we'll answer how you can become overemployed and optimize every second for working 2 full time jobs at the same time.

It seems like I missed blacking out a few peoples eyes. Who did I miss?

Storyyyy time:
---------------

I was sitting on the bed in what my mom called “the shittiest Airbnb in existence”, an attack my dad did not take lightly. He booked it. 

Despite the decrepit half renovated state, the most important phone call of my life happened in that house.
 
“Hi {Mister E}" the caller said "We are pleased to extend an offer to you and would like to start you at $84,500.”

I listened intently but said nothing. 

The speaker continued, “I know this is lower than what you get now but I have been approved to give you a conditional raise in three months," He said. "normally we wait a full year.” 

That's what I was waiting for. An hour later I received the offer letter and signed it.

The first thing I did was take out a piece of paper.

At my current job with Terrill Binch I was making $119,000 a year. Or $9,916/month. After taxes: $7,136.

The new job was offering me $88,500, they initially offered $62,000 but I negotiated them up. Monthly this was $7,376/month. After taxes: $5,526.

Then I added the two after tax numbers together. $207,500. That was my new salary. At 22 years old.

This would be my ticket to financial freedom. 

I stepped out of the room wanting to scream with joy. I made eye-contact with my parents then walked into the kitchen. They couldn't know.

My double life had begun. I was now overemployed.
